# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	Tenki reached the $20 Maya set for the month and she chose to move on, so GitHub takes it
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10 connected=tenki usual=6 ceiling.tenki=20:move spend.tenki=20.40
job	linux	pr	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	0
gone	no
now	1793000000
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux
expect	github	ubuntu-latest	no	offline	own:offline,tenki:ceiling
words	Your machine was offline, so this ran on GitHub.
